stepTitle: Approximately what is the force due to the Bernoulli effect on a roof having an area of $$220\,\text{m}**2?$$ Typical air density in Boulder is $$1.14\,\text{kg/m}**3,$$ and the corresponding atmospheric pressure is $$8.89\times10**{4}\,\text{N/m}**2.$$ (Bernoulli’s principle as stated in the text assumes laminar flow. Using the principle here produces only an approximate result, because there is significant turbulence.) Give the force to three significant figures (in $$\text{N})$$.
